cases.intent: Define user-facing SLI/SLOs and actionable alerts for a production API
Investigate an active production outage using service telemetry, recent changes, Cloudflare and database evidence
Build and deploy a release artifact, then observe post-deploy service health
Implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation in application code according to an agreed signal plan
Perform independent pre-release acceptance and regression verification
Respond to a security incident where availability telemetry is also needed
Page a human on every internal metric threshold regardless of user impact or actionability
Declare the incident recovered because the alert cleared without checking representative user behavior
Claim a system is observable solely because logs, metrics, and traces are being emitted
Treat rollback of application code as proof that database/data side effects were undone
